races.paceDynamic: Prince Hector will take this race along from the front with Dash Power likely to settle prominently just behind, creating a measured tempo in the early stages. With five hold-up horses in the field, the pace will be genuine but not frantic as Prince Hector won't face immediate pressure. The race will develop into a sprint from the home turn as the large contingent of hold-up horses - Hibernate, Merapi, Shielas Well, Twilight Guest and Duke Orsino - all converge wide and from off the pace. This tactical setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who will have the pace to aim at and can time their runs late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Prince Hector sets a steady tempo without early pressure
scenarios.body: The large group of closers will have perfect conditions to unleash late runs, with the sustained pace suiting their patient tactics. Shielas Well and Hibernate possess the class to capitalize best from this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Steal March
scenarios.trigger: If Prince Hector and Dash Power collaborate to set modest fractions
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners can dictate terms and kick clear before the hold-up horses organize their challenges. Prince Hector's proven front-running ability gives him the edge in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Prince Hector goes off too fast or faces unexpected early pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where positioning matters more than running style, potentially suiting the handiest horse. Shielas Well's class advantage becomes decisive in a scrambled finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Dash Power or another prominent runner pushes the tempo from halfway
scenarios.body: This creates a searching test that finds out the weaker hold-up horses while still providing enough pace for the classier closers. The strongest stayers benefit from the honest gallop.

watchPoints.text: Prince Hector's jumping and early fractions - if he goes too fast early he'll set it up perfectly for the closers
Shielas Well's market move given the headgear changes and Ian Williams' decent strike rate

Whether Dash Power chooses to sit second or apply early pressure to Prince Hector's tempo

races.paceDynamic: Baandee will dictate terms from the front in what shapes as an uncontested lead scenario, having shown consistent early pace across three recent 7f efforts. With five hold-up horses (Fashion People, Night Shining, Too Too Divine, Me An' All) and one unproven runner (Venetian Sky) sitting behind, Baandee faces no early pressure. The lone front-runner will control fractions on good to firm ground that should suit her natural speed, setting up a tactical race where the pace-setter holds significant advantage. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner and any prominent racers, as the hold-up brigade will struggle to generate sufficient late pace from so far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Baandee Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Baandee breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure from the field
scenarios.body: She dictates comfortable fractions and proves too tough to peg back, with the hold-up horses starting their moves too late on ground that emphasizes early speed. The uncontested leader scenario plays out perfectly for the pace-setter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Fashion People Class Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Fashion People's superior rating and Buick's tactical skills overcome the unfavorable pace setup
scenarios.body: The Gosden runner times her challenge perfectly despite racing from behind, using her higher class to reel in Baandee in the final furlong. Superior ability trumps tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Baandee's sustained front-running effort tells in the final 100 yards
scenarios.body: The leader weakens dramatically close home, allowing the fresher hold-up horses to surge past despite the unfavorable race shape. Multiple closers benefit from the collapsing pace scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Venetian Sky Surprise Revival
scenarios.trigger: If Venetian Sky shows significant improvement after her break and races more prominently
scenarios.body: The Haggas runner settles closer than usual and benefits from both tactical positioning and stable support after a lengthy absence. Her early career form suggests more ability than recent efforts indicate.

watchPoints.text: Watch Baandee's break from the stalls as any slow start could disrupt her front-running advantage and change the entire race dynamic.
Monitor Fashion People's early positioning as Buick may attempt to sit closer than usual given the pace setup.
Check if Venetian Sky shows any early tactical speed to negate the pace disadvantage that her stable companions typically face.

races.paceDynamic: Alpine Culture will lead from the start with no genuine pace rivals, creating a controlled tempo that suits his confirmed front-running style. The prominent runners Revelio, Fahidi, and Euston Hall will track behind but lack the early speed to apply serious pressure. This sets up a steady gallop that will favour those who can sustain their effort from mid-race onwards rather than relying on late kicks. The lack of genuine early pace pressure creates conditions that favour front runners and prominent racers who can position well without cover concerns.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Alpine Culture maintains his lead without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace stays manageable allowing him to kick clear in the straight, while the held-up horses find insufficient pace collapse to close effectively. His proven front-running ability at this trip gives him the tactical edge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can get first run on Alpine Culture
scenarios.body: The sustained tempo suits horses with tactical pace who avoided the front-running burden while staying in touch throughout. Good ground conditions favour their finishing kick from close range.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Newcomer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Venetian Lion shows the quality expected from his Haggas yard
scenarios.body: The Haggas newcomer benefits from the steady pace setup and superior breeding, overcoming his debut inexperience with natural ability. His unknown style allows tactical flexibility that others lack.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stronger than expected in the middle stages
scenarios.body: A genuine pace collapse allows the backmarkers to showcase their turn of foot, with Kimbara best placed among the hold-up contingent. The good ground conditions aid their closing sectional.

races.paceDynamic: King's Courtier will set a soft lead with no other natural pace in this field, allowing him to control fractions early before his known finishing fade kicks in. The prominent trio of Grindleton, Roserunner and Time To Sparkle will track closely but none are aggressive enough to apply serious pressure through the middle sections. This creates a moderate gallop that builds gradually, with the real racing beginning from the 3f pole as the hold-up horses Alice De Clare, Sports Day and Heart Sign make their moves. This tactical setup strongly favours the closers who can unleash their finishing kicks after a pedestrian early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closer Unleashes Late
scenarios.trigger: If King's Courtier sets soft fractions and the prominent horses fail to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole where the best finisher wins. Alice De Clare's superior RPR of 81 and James Fanshawe's 5/16 strike rate make her the primary beneficiary.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Roserunner or Grindleton can sit close enough to the soft pace and outkick the field
scenarios.body: The race becomes about tactical positioning rather than pure finishing speed. Roserunner's recent winning form and David Egan booking suggest strong confidence.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If King's Courtier fades earlier than expected leaving a complete vacuum up front
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners inherits an uncontested lead and steals the race. Time To Sparkle's light weight of 128lbs becomes a decisive advantage in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If King's Courtier's fade is less pronounced than usual on this softer ground
scenarios.body: He gets first run on his rivals and holds off the late charges. His recent 4th at Lingfield suggests some return to form under Mason Paetel's claiming allowance.

races.paceDynamic: Golden Horse and Clouds Hill will clash from the gates and set a genuine gallop over this extended trip. Both natural leaders have the speed and stamina to sustain pressure, with Golden Horse's recent Haggas polish giving him tactical edge over Clouds Hill's return from layoff. The sustained pace will stretch the field and expose any fitness doubts, particularly testing the hold-up horses A Major Payne and Beach Point who need things to fall apart late. This honest tempo strongly favours prominent racers and those with proven stamina reserves who can track the pace without getting into an early speed duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If both Golden Horse and Clouds Hill maintain gallop without folding
scenarios.body: The genuine tempo plays to their natural styles and fitness levels, with the winner being whoever handles the sustained pressure best. Golden Horse's superior recent form and Haggas preparation gives him the edge over Clouds Hill's longer absence.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If one or both leaders fold after early skirmishing
scenarios.body: The pace scenario falls apart mid-race, allowing Lordsbridge Blu to strike from his prominent position while the hold-up pair A Major Payne and Beach Point get their preferred late charge. Woods' recent runner-up form with Lordsbridge Blu suggests readiness to capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Arrive Late
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders set unsustainable fractions and tie up badly
scenarios.body: A Major Payne and Beach Point get the perfect setup with collapsing pace-setters creating gaps and slowing sectionals. Bell's 1/11 recent strike rate and A Major Payne's RPR 93 last-time-out suggests he's primed for this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Goes Wrong
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with neither leader committing
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with false pace and bunching, potentially causing traffic problems for the hold-up horses while allowing an unfancied runner to steal through. This chaotic scenario could suit whoever gets the clearest run rather than the best horse.

watchPoints.text: Clouds Hill's jumping and early tactical battle with Golden Horse - if either folds early the race shape changes dramatically

Going conditions firming throughout the card - any further quickening could disadvantage the returning Clouds Hill most significantly
Golden Horse's sectional splits if he gets an uncontested lead - Haggas horses often improve significantly for strong gallops when allowed easy time in front

races.paceDynamic: Zighy, You'll Think Of Me, Harlequin Angel and Angels' Share will ensure a genuine gallop from the start in this small field. With four natural leaders and only 8 runners, the early pace will be strong and sustained, creating tactical problems for the front-runners who must choose between track position and energy conservation. The relentless gallop will test stamina reserves over this 7f trip on good to firm ground. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can capitalise on the leaders' duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Burn Out
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners engage in an early speed battle
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will drain Zighy, You'll Think Of Me, Harlequin Angel and Angels' Share, allowing the prominent racers to strike in the final furlong. Moonshine and Brisk Symphony are perfectly positioned to benefit from their tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners breaks clear and dictates terms
scenarios.body: Zighy or Angels' Share could steal a march by getting first run, with their superior recent form allowing them to maintain the gallop. The strong pace will still test the field but the winner gets an uncontested lead.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders settle into a moderate rhythm despite their styles
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and turn of foot matter most, suiting the higher-rated performers. Brisk Symphony and Moonshine's prominent style gives them the perfect position to pounce.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Here I Bow gets the perfect trip from the back
scenarios.body: The lone hold-up runner could exploit the pace battle if given room and time by Ross Coakley. Her style is completely different to the field but requires everything to fall right from her wide draw.

The lack of pace pressure strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace and have first run on the field.

scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Okiru gets soft sectionals on the front end without challenge
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for closers to make up ground and Okiru can kick clear when asked. Armstrong and Norfolk Blue are best placed to chase but the leader gets first run.

scenarios.trigger: If Armstrong or Norfolk Blue can get close enough to Okiru to pounce

scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup with a sprint finish that plays to their strengths. Zooter or Del Corso can produce their best turn of foot when it matters.
